The off-device census proves imports, schemas, and XPU registrations, not numerical execution.

Source comparison found June base dense and grouped W8A8 code in the later source tree, but an off-device census on 2026-08-25 proved the digest-pinned installed August _xpu_C does not register cutlass_grouped_gemm_w8a8_int8_interface. The prior 17 tok/s endpoint log JIT-ran Triton fused_moe_kernel. The complete June package is therefore required for the exact native-MoE control.
